अरे भाइयो और बहनों, बॉक्स ऑफिस पर होने जा रहा है एक खतरनाक क्लैश! 🔥
सलमान खान की रुकी हुई फिल्म Maatrubhumi और श्रद्धा कपूर स्टारर Eetha दोनों 4 December को सिनेमाघरों में आमने-सामने होंगी। 🎬
पर भाईजान ने कोई कॉम्पिटिशन न दिखाते हुए गुरुवार को Instagram Stories पर Eetha का पोस्टर शेयर कर पूरी टीम को शुभकामनाएं दीं। 🌟
Laxman Utekar के निर्देशन में बनी Eetha महाराष्ट्र के पारंपरिक तमाशा और लावणी पर आधारित एक बायोग्राफिकल ड्रामा है। 💃
वहीं Apoorva Lakhia की Maatrubhumi में सलमान खान और Chitrangda Singh नजर आएंगे, जो पहले Battle of Galwan के नाम से चर्चा में थी। 🇮🇳
तो क्या आप पहले सलमान की फिल्म देखेंगे या श्रद्धा की? 🍿

ctx.title: Salman Khan sends best wishes for Shraddha Kapoor's Eetha ahead of its box office clash with Maatrubhumi
ctx.summary: Both Maatrubhumi and Eetha will release in theatres on December 4.
ctx.text:
Salman Khan will be back in theatres with his much-delayed Maatrubhumi in December 4. On the same day, Shraddha Kapoor -starrer Eetha will also release. Even if fans will choose which film to watch first ahead of the box office clash, Salman has displayed no such desire to compete and instead, sent best wishes to the team of Eetha.
On Thursday, Salman took to his Instagram Stories and shared the poster of Eetha. He linked the trailer of the biopic drama in the same, and wrote in the caption, “All the best for Eetha!”
He tagged Shraddha, and Maddock Films in the caption too.
Eetha is a biographical drama directed by Laxman Utekar. The musical drama is rooted in Maharashtra's traditional tamasha and lavani dance forms and inspired by the life of Vithabai Narayangaonkar. Eetha narrates the story of a woman who defied conventions and challenged the odds to chart an unforgettable place in history.
Produced by Dinesh Vijan and Laxman Utekar, the film is presented by Maddock Films and Kathputli Creations with music by Ajay-Atul. The film also features Mohammed Zeeshan Ayyub and Siddharth Jadhav in pivotal roles. The music is composed by Ajay-Atul.
The official logline reads: “Some battles are fought for victory. Some are fought for the future. And some remind us that the greatest victory is when war comes to an end. Presenting the official trailer of #Maatrubhumi : May War Rest in Peace, starring Salman Khan and Chitrangda Singh. A story of courage, sacrifice, humanity and the hope for a world where peace prevails.”
The film, earlier titled Battle of Galwan, has been surrounded by speculation about its storyline and reported changes amid the improving relationship between India and China. It was initially scheduled to release in April, but questions about its narrative have continued to follow the project. Salman dropped the trailer which shows him leading the charge as tensions between Indian and Chinese troops escalate. The trailer also captures the emotional cost of leaving home.
Directed by Apoorva Lakhia, Maatrubhumi: May War Rest in Peace stars Salman Khan and Chitrangda Singh. The film is produced by Salma Khan, with music by Himesh Reshammiya.
